_comment: Every sound the game ships, by output name. kind: music (ACE-Step 1.5 XL turbo, looped), sting (ACE-Step, one-shot), amb (Stable Audio 3, looped), sfx (Stable Audio 3, one-shot). 'variants' makes name-1..name-N; 'takes' candidates are generated per file and the best CLAP match to 'caption' is kept.
